include: Colours are collected by walking the document and counting fills by their normalised upper-case #RRGGBB.
Colours used equally often are ordered in a stable, stated way.
Clicking a swatch gives every selected layer that takes a fill that colour, and the change can be undone.
The list is recomputed or invalidated on the document's change events.
Groups, which have no fills, and layers without fills are skipped.
avoid: Counting one colour written in different cases, or with and without #, as separate swatches.
Counting only top-level layers, so layers inside groups and frames are missed.
